verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms a modern renderer with node-based PBR-style materials (MeshStandardNodeMaterial, TSL) and antialiasing options, and community/GitHub snippets show basic WebGLRenderer setup, but the pack contains no explicit documentation of shadow mapping, baked lighting/GI, or a post-processing pipeline (EffectComposer). A community comment even asks uncertainly whether lightmaps/baked lighting are possible, rather than confirming it. missing for 10: shadow-map documentation, GI/baked-lighting pipeline, post-processing/EffectComposer evidence, independent corroboration of PBR fidelity.
